denoise.title: Denoise
denoise.caption: Grain from a very high ISO setting is removed while the strawberry seeds and leaf edges stay. Photo: Alexis Jazz, CC0.

sharpen.title: Sharpen
sharpen.caption: Restores crisp edges to a soft photo without halos. The softness here was simulated with a slight blur. Photo: Jebulon, CC0.

unblur_motion.title: Unblur: Motion
unblur_motion.caption: Removes a smear in one direction, from camera shake or a moving subject. The shake here was simulated (21 px). Photo: Jebulon, CC0.

unblur_focus.title: Unblur: Focus
unblur_focus.caption: Recovers a photo that is evenly soft because the focus missed. The defocus here was simulated (7 px). Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC0.

face.title: Face
face.meta: 1927 magazine scan · face, strength 1.0 · shown at 2×
face.caption: Restores faces it detects (128 px or larger) and leaves the rest of the photo alone. Real 1927 print scan. Photo: Harris & Ewing, public domain.

upscale2x.title: Upscale 2×
upscale2x.meta: 800 px photo enlarged to 1600 px · upscale2x
upscale2x.caption: Doubles the width and height with real detail. Before is a standard (bicubic) enlargement of the same crop. Photo: Wilfredor, CC0.

pipeline.title: Several steps at once
pipeline.meta: Noisy, soft, small · denoise 0.6 → sharpen 0.3 → upscale 2×
pipeline.caption: Up to four steps run in order in one pass on the server. Before is a bicubic enlargement. Noise, blur and size were simulated. Photo: Wilfredor, CC0.
